submission.justification: Radiator-R2 at 3 cm thickness is recommended as it provides the best pion/kaon separation performance (3.68σ) among all radiators that meet the lifetime durability requirement. While Radiator-R3 shows superior separation (4.722σ at 3cm), it fails to maintain performance over the experiment's lifetime and must be excluded. Radiator-R1, though durable, provides significantly lower separation (2.985σ at 3cm). The 3 cm thickness represents the optimal point for R2, balancing signal strength and resolution within the allowed 1-6 cm range.
